- Release ID:
- Source PR:
- Target environment:

## Required Gates

- CI status:
- AI gate status:

## Staging Smoke

Record the command, URL, or workflow used to prove the release can run outside a
developer workstation.

## Rollback Plan

State the exact rollback action, expected time to recover, and data recovery
considerations.

## Monitoring Plan

Name the logs, dashboards, jobs, and checks watched after rollout.
